name: eggs
description: AK Enterprises Operations System: one shared core, five role-specific apps

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm db:up
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev --name init && pnpm seed
